tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind the sidebar and around the main panel. Sidebar text sits on it: `ink`, `ink-2`, `ink-3`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The main panel every page lives in, and the properties rail. The default reading ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the command menu, inputs and secondary buttons — anything that floats above `panel`.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Quiet fill: row hover, segmented-control track, op-type tags, the timer chip at rest.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The selected row or nav item, and pressed states. All text tokens stay legible on it.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers inside lists and between the rail and the main column. Never around sections — space separates sections.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs and secondary buttons at rest (decorative: the label, not the line, identifies the control).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Checkbox and toggle outlines and any edge that must be seen — 3:1 on `panel` and `raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every ground: `canvas`, `panel`, `raised`, `fill`, `selected`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text — descriptions, meta lines, inactive tabs — on every ground.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text — property labels, placeholders, timestamps, counts. Smallest legible tone: 4.5:1 on every ground incl. `selected`.

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative glyphs only. Never for information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Bronze / champagne. The one accent: the accent button fill, the focus ring, the current stage, the running clock. One accent control per view.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text (links such as “Transfer…”, the current stage name) on every ground and on `accent-tint`.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the Next-step strip and the selected command-menu row. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-2`, `accent-text`.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Hairline in accent — the Next-step strip edge, stage-track current segment track.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (the accent button label).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill — ink, inverted in dark. Calmer than colour; use for the main action of a view (Start clock).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill.

tokens.name: status-hold
tokens.usage: Hold tech and Declined icons (empty ring / crossed disc). Icon colour only — the status word stays `ink`.

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: Working and Complete icons (half disc / checked disc). Icon colour only.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Waiting – Parts and Waiting – Foreman icons (dashed ring). Icon colour only.

tokens.name: status-customer
tokens.usage: Waiting – Customer icon (dashed ring). Icon colour only.

tokens.name: status-support
tokens.usage: Waiting – Tech support icon (dashed ring), and DIAG op tags. Icon colour only.

tokens.name: status-problem
tokens.usage: Escalated, overdue and over-quote marks; the overrun part of the time bar. Icon colour only.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Good numbers as text (efficiency at or above 100%) on `panel`, `raised`, `fill`, `good-tint`.

tokens.name: good-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind a good notice. Rare.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution numbers as text (under 0.5 h left) on `panel`, `raised`, `fill`, `warn-tint`.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind a caution notice. Rare.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Bad numbers and danger text (over quote, Delete RO) on `panel`, `raised`, `fill`, `bad-tint`.

tokens.name: bad-tint
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a danger item; background of an error notice.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the command menu and dialogs.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: The RO page title — the customer's name. One per page.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on list pages (RO list, Triage, Warranty) and dialog titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page: Operations, Activity.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and operation titles, menu group names in dialogs.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text: notes, work performed, descriptions.
styles.sample: Clutch slips under load, no free play left.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Row titles, buttons, tabs, property values that need weight.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines and property values in the rail.
styles.sample: Opened Oct 6 · Lot D5 · Dana Kowalski

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Property labels, tab counts, captions. Sentence case — never all caps.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Keyboard hints and badge counts only.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: The running clock on an operation. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Numbers in the time stats row and money totals. Tabular figures.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Identifiers: RO number, VIN, part numbers, case numbers, key tags.

styles.name: id-sm
styles.usage: Op-type tags (DIAG, OP, PM, WARR, COMEBACK, SUBLET) and identifiers in dense lists.

spacing.note: 4-pt scale. Rhythm: 16 inside a group, 32 between groups, 48 between sections.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips and tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; icon-to-label in buttons and rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding (vertical 10–12), menu padding, gap inside a group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside a group: between fields, rows of a card, rail rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel header side padding; Next-step strip padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between related blocks (title → stage track).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups (stage track → operations).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Main column top padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections (operations → activity); main column side padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page bottom breathing room.

radius.note: Soft, never round — except status icons, avatars, the play button and the toast.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard hints, the time-bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Op-type tags, small chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, nav items, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the Next-step strip, the time card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The main panel and the command menu.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status icons, the play/stop button, the toast.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs (in rows and the rail).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The play/stop button and dialog inputs.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Operation rows and list rows.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Main panel header (breadcrumb bar).

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width (collapses to 56px, icons only).

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Properties rail width on the RO page.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the main reading column.

shadow.note: Nothing casts a shadow at rest except the main panel's edge.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The main panel's edge on `canvas`. The only resting shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the command menu, the toast.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in `panel`, then a solid 2px `accent` ring (≥4.6:1 on every ground).
